projects.title: Deep Reinforcement Operator Learning for Dynamic Control
projects.where: Institute for Advanced Research, United International University · PI: Dr. Mahtab Uddin
bullets: Developed a physics-informed dual-critic PPO controller with a DeepONet surrogate for river-pollution control. Compared with standard PPO, it reduced integrated pollutant exceedance by 11.65% and violation duration by 10.85%, with a surrogate relative L_{2} error of 2.21% {pub:dual-critic-ppo-river-pollution}.
Extended the approach to safe control with Fourier neural operators and control barrier functions for battery thermal-runaway cooling {pub:fno-cbf-rl-battery}.
Contributed to DeepONet-guided reinforcement-learning stabilisation of the chaotic Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation {pub:rol-kuramoto-sivashinsky}.

projects.title: Uncertainty-aware inverse parameter estimation
projects.where: Identifiability-aware, uncertainty-weighted PINNs for advection–diffusion–reaction systems
projects.summary: Recovering physical parameters from sparse, noisy observations while accounting for which parameters the data can actually identify {pub:uw-pinn-adr-inverse}.

projects.title: Vision-based robotic teleoperation
projects.summary: Designed and assembled a 6-DOF aluminium manipulator (high-torque servos, ESP32 controller, PCA9685 PWM driver over I^{2}C). I am now developing stereo-camera hand tracking on an RDK X5 edge-AI computer for learning-based teleoperation.

projects.title: Embedded biomedical AI
projects.summary: Evaluated a calibrated multiview ECG abnormality-screening model on embedded hardware for low-cost, on-device screening {pub:morphcal-ecg}.

projects.title: Hybrid weather prediction
projects.summary: Contributed to a WRF–deep learning lightning-prediction model for hotspots in Bangladesh, funded by the Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of Bangladesh.

projects.title: Atmospheric simulation
projects.summary: Simulated tropical cyclones with WRF and analysed their dynamical parameters.

projects.title: Numerical and reduced-order modelling
projects.summary: Wrote a shallow-water-equation solver in Fortran; reconstructed flow fields with proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) and dynamic mode decomposition (DMD).

projects.title: Multiphysics simulation
projects.summary: COMSOL studies of flow past multiple cylinders, heat transfer, structural response and Darcy porous-media transport; SolidWorks motion study of a slider-crank mechanism.
